meta.title: Motion demo (T0.6)
meta.author: Soundstage
meta.description: Scroll, timeline and pointer clocks driving compiled tracks.

spans.text: Scroll to play the scene. Every layer is a track on the scroll clock.
This is a flow scene: it scrolls like a page section, and its own scroll clock runs from 0 when its top enters the viewport to 1 when its bottom leaves. The rule above grows with it.
Pinned scenes hold the stage still while their clock runs from 0 to 1 over their scroll length.
A timeline clock (pingPong, plays on scene enter) and two pointer clocks. Move the mouse over the stage.
The next scene animates 56 tiles with six tracks each (336 tracks) on a smoothed scroll clock. It is the performance-trace scene.
Clocks are sources; tracks are compiled; render objects take the values directly. Scrolling rebuilds no widgets.
